description: A galvanized steel mailbox on a wooden post at dusk, its open flap stuffed with envelopes, with a heavy chain wrapped around it and a padlock hanging from the chain. Behind it sits a single-storey stucco house with a dark shingled roof and a tall palm tree, under a deep blue sky with an orange glow on the horizon. A neighbouring house and fence are partly visible at the left edge. No people, no visible text.
